final: WITH joined AS (SELECT o.mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS diff FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink), per_pair AS (SELECT mktnote, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM joined GROUP BY mktnote), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS avg_pair_diff FROM per_pair), kept AS (SELECT p.avg_diff, p.avg_diff - x.avg_pair_diff AS excess FROM per_pair AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS x WHERE p.avg_diff > x.avg_pair_diff) SELECT AVG(avg_diff), AVG(excess) FROM kept
